## Offers API collection

This API is designed to allow for CuneXus offer information to POST to third parties or for consumption by the Financial institution.

This collection contains sample request from the [Offers API](https://{{OffersApiHost}})

It contains the following requests:

- Get All Widgets
- Get Active Campaigns
- Retrieve Offers
- Retrieve Offers by Ncr Guid
- Get Credit Data for Customer ID
- Accept Offers
